_note: قوالب Supabase Auth الأصلية (قبل قوالب CODpromo، 24 أكتوبر 2026) — للرجوع إليها: الصق subject و body في نفس القالب من Authentication → Emails → Templates.

confirm-sign-up.subject: Confirm your email address
confirm-sign-up.body:
Confirm your email address

Follow the link below to confirm this email address and finish signing up.

Confirm email address

invite-user.subject: You've been invited
invite-user.body:
You've been invited

You've been invited to create an account. Follow the link below to accept.

Accept invitation

magic-link-or-otp.subject: Your sign-in link
magic-link-or-otp.body:
Your sign-in link

Follow the link below to sign in. This link expires shortly and can only be used once.

Sign in

change-email-address.subject: Confirm your new email address
change-email-address.body:
Confirm your new email address

Follow the link below to confirm {{ .NewEmail }} as your new email address.

Confirm new email address

If you didn't request this change, you can safely ignore this email.

reset-password.subject: Reset your password
reset-password.body:
Reset your password

We received a request to reset your password. Follow the link below to choose a new one.

Reset password

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

reauthentication.subject: {{ .Token }} is your verification code
reauthentication.body:
Your verification code

Use the code below to verify your identity. It expires shortly.

{{ .Token }}
